notes.title: Graphical Overhaul Update!
notes.notes:
Hello all!

This is a huge update for The Forgotten Isles! I've been wanting to overhaul the graphics as a final update for a while now but haven't gotten around to it. Well now it's done!

[b]What's new?[/b]
Almost every single object has been updated with a new model and some levels have received balancing changes.


[b]What does this mean for the future?[/b]
I'm done updating the game aside from any bugs people find, I'm off to work on other projects and learn new things. This project has served its purpose as a way to teach me what it takes to release on steam and now I know! 

If you're interested in joining my discord you can do so here:
https://discord.gg/YdDaGATKah


Please enjoy my humble little game.

That's all for now.
Thanks.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Hey there!

Here's a small update!

[b]Changes[/b]
Changed model of cherry tree on water levels. Leaves are fuller and more performant.

[b]Additions[/b]
Add new pickup Porta-Island! Pick it up and throw it to spawn a new island to jump on! Currently only enabled in endless mode.

notes.title: Endless mode improvements
notes.notes:
Hey all, here's another small update!

[b]Changes[/b]
- Boost circles in endless mode now face the correct direction instead of off into the distance
- Endless mode islands now spawn in a less chaotic way
- Endless mode islands no longer spawn with missing trees
- Added loading screen for larger levels

That's all! If you find any issues or have suggestions, feel free to join my discord!
https://discord.gg/YdDaGATKah

notes.notes:
[b]BUG FIXES[/b]

-Fixed and issue with the snow levels not saving player progress
- Fixed the snow world endless image

[b]KNOWN BUGS[/b]

- Player ghosts move at different speeds if vsync is off -- working to fix this.

notes.title: Player Ghosts and Optimizations
notes.notes:
[b]PLAYER GHOST AND MINOR OPTIMIZATION[/b]

Hey hey,
I've finally implemented player ghosts! 
After completing a level, your movement will be recorded and played the next time you play that level again. You'll be able to see what path you took the previous run as well as have something physical to race!

[b]GOOD NEWS[/b]

Players are able to access ghosts without losing their current high scores/progress! However since no data for ghosts has been recorded, you must replay levels for a ghost to be recorded there.

[b]MINOR OPTIMIZATIONS[/b]

- Removed tree colliders as they were un-needed and just slowed players down
- Removed some annoying rocks
- Working on removing all mesh colliders on rocks

[b]JOIN THE DISCORD[/b]
Interested in more frequent updates? Join the discord! Send some suggestions or just hang out!
Discord invite: https://discord.gg/YdDaGATKah

notes.title: Controller Sensitivity
notes.notes:
[b]Controller sensitivity increase[/b]
I've increased the base controller sensitivity to more accurately match the mouse. Switching between the two should be less jarring. Let us know if you find anything else that needs changing or features to add!

[b]Join our discord to report bugs or suggest features![/b]
https://discord.gg/YdDaGATKah

notes.title: Quick Patch - Tutorial Level
notes.notes: A couple of features were missing from the tutorial leaving some users unsure how to use certain mechanics/controls. The tutorial level has since been updated to explain all necessary controls and mechanics. Let us know if you find any issues!

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS RELEASE!
notes.notes:
[b]Early access is here![/b]
This is a huge step for any developer, especially for myself! Thank you to all of you who choose to support this game and my ideas!



[b]BUGS[/b]
And as always, with first launch -- bugs are to be found! If you find a bug let me know by joining my discord ( invite link: https://discord.gg/jUd7drYc )  and sending a message or email me at: phantomprogramming@tutanota.com.

I'll fix all the bugs I can ASAP! Please understand my internet conditions dont allow for quick uploads so while I may have fixed a bug, it could take 30min-2hr before you get an update about it. Thank you for your patience! 

[b]Enjoy my game![/b]
